About.missionP1: Rain falls on our roofs, yet its potential often goes unnoticed. We believe understanding that potential is a meaningful first step towards making better use of the water around us.
About.missionP2: Our mission is to make rainwater-harvesting potential easier to explore. Water Warriors AI brings location and rooftop area together to help homeowners, offices and buildings see what could be possible for their property.
About.missionQuote: Make the first step towards rainwater harvesting an informed one.
About.missionCaption: From rainfall to a resource: a different way to look at the water that reaches your roof.
About.missionCard: Water Warriors is a tool designed to help homeowners, building managers, and sustainability advocates understand the rainwater harvesting potential of their properties. Every year, billions of litres of fresh rainwater are lost to runoff because we lack the tools to visualize its potential. We are changing that.

rajeshSeshadri.tagline: Environmentalist at heart, IT by profession.
rajeshSeshadri.description: My commitment to the environment isn't just an interest; it's a calling. After spearheading numerous CSR initiatives—planting trees on a massive scale and building infrastructure to harvest and recharge our precious groundwater—I saw something that changed me. I witnessed the staggering, heartbreaking waste of rainwater in our communities. I knew right then that simply observing the problem wasn't enough; it demanded relentless action. That realization became the catalyst for Water Warriors. Capturing this wasted resource and turning this crisis into a sustainable future isn't just a project for me—it is my life's mission.

jaiPrakash.description: Driving technology and innovation to create meaningful environmental impact. Focused on building scalable digital solutions, intelligent systems, and technology-driven strategies that make rainwater harvesting more accessible and effective. At Water Warriors, the goal is to combine technology, innovation, and sustainability to create lasting change.

anandRajuMudunuri.description: Anand takes industrial climate goals from ambition to audited outcomes. With 15+ years of experience, he has advised EU and Indian clients on GHG accounting, disclosure, net-zero strategy and climate risk. He has developed climate adaptation frameworks, delivered capacity building programs, and built tools that became client-facing services. Conceptualization and execution of carbon projects, including mangrove restoration, biogas and plantation, and their subsequent registration under Gold Standard® certification has been his major accomplishment. At Water Warriors AI, he brings this climate and decarbonisation expertise to one purpose: making every drop count.

subashChandraReddy.description: Bringing technical knowledge and industry insights to support innovative water conservation initiatives. Focused on exploring practical solutions, strengthening technical strategies, and helping communities adopt sustainable rainwater harvesting practices.

Education.bannerDescription: We help homeowners, offices and buildings discover their rainwater-harvesting potential, one property at a time.

0.title: Catch
0.description: Your roof collects the rain that falls on it — the larger the roof, the more water you can capture.

1.title: Channel
1.description: Gutters and downpipes carry the water away from the roof edge to a single collection point.

2.title: Clean
2.description: A first-flush diverter sends the dirtiest first rain away, and a mesh or sand filter removes leaves and grit.

3.title: Store or Recharge
3.description: The clean water is either stored in a tank for later use or guided into the ground through a recharge pit.

Education.option1Description: Collect rainwater in a covered tank or sump and use it for gardening, cleaning, flushing and other non-drinking needs. It reduces the water you draw from taps, borewells or tankers.
Education.option2Description: Direct rainwater into a recharge pit, trench or old well so it soaks back into the soil. This helps replenish the groundwater that borewells in your neighbourhood depend on.

tips.0: Clean roofs, gutters and downpipes before the rainy season starts.
tips.1: Check and wash filters and first-flush diverters after heavy storms.
tips.2: Keep tanks covered and screened to keep out debris, insects and sunlight.
tips.3: Inspect recharge pits each year and clear silt so water keeps soaking in.

Privacy.bannerDescription: This policy explains what information Water Warriors AI LLP (“Water Warriors”, “we”) handles when you use this website, why, who else receives it, and the choices you have.

inShort.0: You don't need an account to use the calculator.
inShort.1: The area you draw stays in your browser. We send its location to the services that do the calculations, but we don't store it on our servers.
inShort.2: We use Google Analytics cookies only if you accept them. Google may also set cookies for maps and, when ads are shown, for advertising.

0.title: The area you draw
0.body: When you draw a rooftop or open area on the map, its outline, size and location are kept in your browser for the current session. To produce your results, the location and size are sent to the services listed below for rainfall, groundwater and local impact analysis. We don't keep them on our servers, except that groundwater extraction results are cached for 24 hours under a scrambled code of the area's shape, so a repeat request is faster.

1.title: Your name
1.body: If you type your name for the greeting, it stays in your browser for the current session and isn't sent to us.

2.title: Saved rooftops
2.body: Rooftops you save on the Measure page are stored only on your device.

3.title: Paid reports
3.body: Payments are handled by Razorpay. Your card, UPI or bank details go to Razorpay, not to us. We receive the order and payment IDs to confirm the payment. The infographic is created from your report figures by the image service selected for the site (getimg.ai or Google Gemini).

4.title: PDF reports
4.body: Download PDF Report is created entirely in your browser. Print to PDF sends a copy of your report page to Browserless or to our own server at Amazon Web Services, which turns it into a PDF using a single-use link that expires shortly afterwards.

5.title: Contact and feedback
5.body: When you send a message, what you enter (for example your name, email, phone number, organisation and message) is emailed to us through Resend. It isn't stored in our database. We keep the email as long as we need it to reply and follow up.

6.title: Visitor counter
6.body: The footer shows how many people have visited and from which countries. To find your country, our server sends your IP address to ipwho.is or ipapi.co. We store only the country count, not your IP address, and your browser keeps a note so you're counted once.

7.title: Site analytics
7.body1: We use Google Analytics to understand how the site is used: which pages are visited, the device and browser, roughly where visitors are (country and city, worked out by Google from the IP address), how they arrived, and actions such as drawing an area (sent as a size band, never the exact area or its location), creating or downloading a report (with the city and state), starting or completing a payment (with the amount), and sending a contact or feedback form (never its contents). Admin pages are not measured.
7.body2: We ask before Google Analytics uses cookies. If you decline, or until you choose, it receives only cookieless signals that don't identify your browser. You can change your choice at any time with <cookieSettings>Cookie settings</cookieSettings> at the bottom of any page. We have turned off Google signals and ad personalisation for analytics. See <googlePrivacy>Google's Privacy Policy</googlePrivacy>, or install the <optOut>Google Analytics opt-out add-on</optOut>.

8.title: Advertising
8.body: When ads are switched on for this site, they are provided by Google AdSense. Google and its partners use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this and other websites. You can read <googleInfo>how Google uses information from sites that use its services</googleInfo> and turn off personalised ads in <adCenter>My Ad Center</adCenter>. Ads never appear in your PDF reports.

9.title: Server logs
9.body: Our hosting and back-end providers keep standard technical logs, such as IP address, browser type and time of request, to run the site securely.

Privacy.cookiesIntro: We don't set cookies ourselves. The site uses your browser's storage for the items below. “Session” items are deleted when you close the tab; “Device” items stay until you clear your browser data.

0.name: site_authenticated
0.purpose: Remembers that you signed in to the site

1.name: water_warrior_* (polygon points, location, name, map view, report access)
1.purpose: Carries the area you drew, its location, the name you typed and your map view from page to page

2.name: rooftop-projects
2.purpose: Rooftops you save on the Measure page

3.name: ww_analytics_consent
3.purpose: Remembers whether you accepted or declined analytics cookies

4.name: water_warrior_country_counted
4.purpose: Makes sure you are counted only once in the visitor counter

Privacy.cookiesOutro: If you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics sets the _ga cookie and one named after our property (_ga_ followed by an ID), which last up to 2 years. Google Maps and, when ads are shown, Google AdSense may set their own cookies, as described in Google's policies.

retention.0: Session items in your browser: until you close the tab.
retention.2: Print to PDF links: single use, expiring within minutes.
retention.3: Contact and feedback emails: as long as needed to reply and follow up.
retention.4: Visitor counts: country totals only, kept indefinitely.
retention.5: Google Analytics data: 14 months, then deleted by Google.

rights.0: You can clear the site's browser storage at any time in your browser settings.
rights.1: You can accept or decline analytics cookies with Cookie settings at the bottom of any page.
rights.2: You can block or delete cookies in your browser, and turn off personalised ads in My Ad Center.
rights.3: Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and similar laws, you can ask us what personal data we hold about you, ask us to correct or delete it, and raise a grievance. We will respond within a reasonable time.

Privacy.children: This site is intended for adults. We don't knowingly collect personal data from children under 18. If you believe a child has sent us personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.
Privacy.security: Information is sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS), and access to our back end is limited to the people who run the site. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information.
Privacy.changes: We will update this page when our practices change and revise the date at the top.
Privacy.contact: For questions, requests about your data or grievances, please write to us through the <contactUs>Contact Us</contactUs> page and choose “Question”.
